import_dialog.title: Import a DSH plugin
import_dialog.description: A plugin is an npm package whose manifest declares a bundle patch. Paste what you would give to `dsh plugin add`.
import_dialog.source_help: Accepts npm:name@version, github:owner/repo#ref, or an https tarball URL.
import_dialog.upload_help: A .zip or .tgz. Accepts an npm pack, a GitHub download, or a plain folder.
